qexed.crates.language.config.LanguageCon: Whether language configuration is enabled, default %{default}
Language identifier to use, e.g. zh-CN or en-US, default %{default}

Server to download language files from; defaults to the official docs site. When unset, missing translations fall back to raw keys.
Routes:
- `GET /api/v1/qexed/{commit}/language.json`: list supported languages
- `GET /api/v1/qexed/{commit}/{language}.json`: translations for one language
- `GET /api/v1/{author}/{plugin}/{commit}/language.json`: list languages of one plugin
- `GET /api/v1/{author}/{plugin}/{commit}/{language}.json`: translations of one plugin
When server_url and the plugin's own language files are both unavailable, fall back per plugin author: author name → server URL
When even the author's server fails, a server URL configured for a single plugin; two-level mapping: author name → plugin name → server URL
